	static int mod=998244353;
	static long fastpow(long n,long ti) {
		long result = 1;
		long base = n % mod;
		while (ti > 0) {
			if ((ti & 1) == 1) {
				result = (result * base) % mod;
			}
			base = (base * base) % mod;
			ti >>= 1;
		}
		return result;
	}
	static long[]fac;
	
	public static long ncr(int n,int k) {
		if(n<k)return 0;
		long num=fac[(n)];
		long den=(fac[(n-k)]*fac[k])%mod;
		long ans=(num*fastpow(den,mod-2));
		return ans%mod;
	}

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main{
	static int mod=998244353;
	static long fastpow(long n,long ti) {
		 if (ti == 0) 
		        return 1l;
		if(ti%2==0) {
			long y=fastpow(n, ti/2);
			long k=y*y;
			k%=mod;
			return k;
		}
		else {
			long y=fastpow(n, ti/2);
			long k=((n*y)%mod)*y;
			k%=mod;
			return k;
		}
	}
	
	// compute nCr using multiplicative formula with modular inverses
	static long ncr(int n, int k) {
		if (k < 0 || k > n) return 0;
		if (k == 0 || k == n) return 1;
		long res = 1;
		// use symmetry: choose smaller k
		if (k > n - k) k = n - k;
		for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
			res = res * (n - i + 1) % mod;
			res = res * fastpow(i, mod - 2) % mod;
		}
		return res;
	}
	
	public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception{
		BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
		StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
		int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
		long k = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
		
		if(k>=n) {
			System.out.println(0);
			return;
		}
		if(k==0) {
			// compute n! on the fly
			long fact = 1;
			for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) fact = fact * i % mod;
			System.out.println(fact);
			return;
		}
		if(k==n-1) {
			System.out.println(2*n);
			return;
		}
		//columns to fill with one rook
		int filledCols=(int)(n-k);
		
		long waysToChooseFilledCols=ncr(n, filledCols);
		
		long ans=0;
		int sign = 1; // sign for inclusion-exclusion
		for(int emptyCols=0;emptyCols<=filledCols;emptyCols++) {
			long waysToChoose=ncr(filledCols, emptyCols);
			long waysToFill=fastpow(filledCols-emptyCols, n);
			long val=(waysToChoose*waysToFill)%mod;
			
			if (sign == -1) {
				val = (mod - val) % mod;
			}
			ans = (ans + val) % mod;
			sign = -sign; // toggle sign for next iteration
		}
		ans=(ans*waysToChooseFilledCols)%mod;
		
		//the same for rows
		ans=(ans*2)%mod;
		
		System.out.println(ans);
	}
